daily.title: Ligue 1 : l’OM s’incline face au Paris FC, Strasbourg et Rennes enchaînent les victoires
daily.summary: Marseille s’enfonce tandis que le Paris FC s’installe en haut du classement et que Strasbourg, qui a largement battu Troyes, impressionne par son attaque.

daily.title: Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport, killing at least five
daily.summary: At least five people were killed and five injured after an Amazon cargo plane overshot the runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday and crashed into several vehicles, officials said. Miami Sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz said there was “no apparent threat to public safety” following the crash.

daily.title: A Miami, un avion-cargo d’Amazon sort de piste, faisant cinq morts et cinq blessés

daily.title: Egyptian TV presenter Sarah Khalifa sentenced to death in drug case

daily.title: Israeli strikes kill four in Lebanon after alleged Hezbollah drone launch

Israel's military said that the strikes were a response to an alleged Hezbollah drone launch targeting troops in the Israeli-occupied "security zone" in the country's south.

Face au vide identitaire, beaucoup entament un travail de reconstruction, passant par la thérapie, le soutien de pairs ou la réappropriation d’une culture d’origine oubliée.
